scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exact last-vertex law, compressed inverse reconstruction, realizability, stability, and all-start uniformity rigidity.
scientific_integrity.priority_status: Targeted comparison only, not independent priority certification.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytical derivation and self-review; finite exact independent checks attached.

scientific_limitations: Requires a known labelled cycle with at least three vertices and positive time-independent symmetric edge conductances.
Recovers conductances only up to common factor; no identification claim for arbitrary nonreversible chains.
Finite checker validates examples, not all real weights; generality comes from the proof.
The motivating 2026 paper was available by abstract but not by complete manuscript; independent historical priority remains unresolved.
title: Cover-endpoint tomography of conductance cycles: exact law and inverse rigidity
